description: List PostgreSQL buildfarm animals. Filterable by OS, branch tracked, last build status, or owner. Failing animals are returned first (sort key: last_status='failed' DESC, name ASC).

branch.description: Restrict to animals tracking this PostgreSQL branch (e.g. master, REL_18_STABLE)

os.description: Restrict to animals running this OS (exact match against ag_buildfarm_animals.os)

owner.description: Restrict to a single owner_name or owner_email (exact match)

status.description: Restrict to animals with this last_status: passed, failed, flapping, unknown

name: list_animals
